FAQ

## Questions people ask.

Which devices does Remindly run on?

There are native apps for iPhone (iOS 18 or later), iPad (iPadOS 18 or later) and Mac (macOS 15 or later), plus a web app. On Windows, install the web app from Edge or Chrome: it opens in its own window, but it needs a connection, because your notes aren't stored on the PC. There's no Android app. [...] Light on purpose

## Opening a note never waits on the network.

Remindly does a short list of things and keeps them fast. There's nothing to load and nothing to wait for.

### On your device

Every note is stored on your iPhone, iPad and Mac, so opening one or typing never waits for a server.

### Works offline

Read, write and search on a plane or in a basement. Changes sync when you're back online.

### Edits merge

Change the same note on two devices and Remindly merges the edits when it can, instead of handing you two copies.

Search

## Search that reads your photos, too.

Remindly finds words inside PDFs, scanned documents and pictures. The text is recognized on your own device, not on a server. [...] Quick Capture

Never forget to do something thanks to Remindly.
Remindly is the fastest way to create a reminder. The instant something crosses your mind, just open Remindly and start typing right away. Within a few seconds you’ve created your reminder and can get back to what you were doing.
Thoughtfully designed to stay out of your way, Remindly integrates with the Reminders app that comes with your iPhone. To help you in the process, the app allows you to customise some handy shortcuts for both places and times so you can be reminded whenever matters most.
- Create tasks on the fly
- Be reminded when you arrive or leave your preferred locations
- Or select a customisable shortcut for a time of day most suited to your lifestyle [...] # Remindly
